ValidationRule.description: When Status is Completed or Refused, Result must carry the matching value — prevents the two outcome fields from disagreeing (found live: a record with Status=Refused but Result=Completed and no remarks).
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR( ISPICKVAL(AF_Status__c, "Completed"), ISPICKVAL(AF_Status__c, "Refused") ), NOT(TEXT(AF_Status__c) = TEXT(AF_Result__c)) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Test Drive Result must match Status when Status is Completed or Refused — set Result to the same value.
